title: Vacation from Kenton, first marriage and the house in Reseda
summary: He took a break from Kenton, moved into his first house in Reseda, and mentions an earlier marriage not to Nancy.

blocks.x: Then, by August of ‟53, we‟re showing more recordings with Stan Kenton.
So you left, and you went back.
Yeah. It was just a vacation. I think I came home. We moved into our first house. I had to help do that.
When you say “we,” by then you were already married?
Yeah. I got married at the end of ‟49, I think. No, not to Nancy.
So you moved into what neighborhood in Los Angeles at that point?
Out in Reseda. That‟s where the cheap houses were.
